nodes.label: Tribhuvan University (T.U.) Logo Crest
nodes.rationale: A circular crest: navy blue ring with a gold outer border, a white interior containing a stylized open book/monument form with a gold chevron above it, and the letters 'T.U.' in white serif capitals on a navy band at the bottom. It is the Tribhuvan University emblem used as the front-page institutional logo in both the DOCX and LaTeX outputs via FrontPage.logo_path.
